data_section_full_text:
Our initial sample consists of 19,504 firm-year observations with ExecuComp data for the
period 1995–2005. We lose 1,594 firm-year observations because of missing First Call data.
Merging our sample with the COMPUSTAT ⁄ CRSP ⁄ IRRC data sets results in a loss of
another 3,595 firm-years. The final sample consists of 14,315 firm-year observations, as
shown in Table 1.

We collect our sample of management forecasts from the First Call database of Company Issued Guidance (CIG). We identify a sample of annual management earnings forecasts for the years 1995–2005 and only include quantitative management earnings forecasts
such as point and range forecasts. When the forecast provides a range, we use the midpoint of the range as the management forecast. <sup>3</sup>
